name: fileway
description: Runtime-agnostic file storage engine for JavaScript/TypeScript: one standard API for every storage provider and runtime, with zero core dependencies.

scripts.test:integration: RUN_MINIO_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter @fileway/driver-s3 exec vitest run src/minio.integration.test.ts
scripts.release:commit: git add -A && git commit -m "chore: release v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")"
scripts.release: pnpm run version:patch && pnpm run release:commit && pnpm run release:tag && pnpm run release:push
